rules: No-fail: an off result still pays the base price and offers a gentle redo; reviews never go below 3★ and rep never goes down.
Tips are % of the drink's base price (products.json owns prices).
Rep points feed rep_star_gates [0,2,6,12,20,30] in tuning.json; event rep is 0-2.
chance is rolled once per eligible check; cooldown_orders counts orders served since the event last fired. Max one general event active at a time.
Line ids are placeholders for Narrative Writer: line_<event_id>_<beat>. Existing names come from narrative/stand_minigame.md.
Customer lines added for Narrative Writer's 8 customers all start with line_cust_ (signature events: line_cust_<customer>_<event>_<beat>; cameos in existing events: line_cust_<customer>_<beat>).
Customers (narrative/customers/customers.json) appear from appears_from; before their favourite_drink unlocks they order slice_order.

customers.name: Lorna (Lamp_Lady)
customers.pronouns: she/her (explicit: 'Lamp Lady' is her chosen handle)

trigger.when: first stand session after classic_lemonade unlocks; first customer

steps: Neighbor kid walks up holding a fistful of quarters.
Orders classic lemonade, 'quiet straw, please'.
Tutorial prompts show the 3 steps (lemons → sugar → ice).
events.resolve: Make the classic lemonade (tutorial-guided; can't fail).

great.extra: Kid drops a quarter in the tip jar; first 5★ review lands.

off.extra: Kid sips anyway: 'it's still lemonade!'

events.notes: Teaches the order → make → serve loop and introduces reviews.

trigger.when: first order of Pink Lemonade after it unlocks

steps: The cat cafe owner stops by with Biscuit in a carrier.
Asks for 'the pink one, like his nose'.
Biscuit watches the pitcher.
events.resolve: Make pink lemonade; optional: keep the pour steady (Biscuit tracks the stream).

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Iced Tea Lemonade after it unlocks with weather = after_rain (forced for the first session after L3)

steps: Rain stops; the sidewalk sparkles.
A cyclist in a dripping jacket orders iced tea lemonade.
The tea needs a short cool step.
Dottie waves the soggy line in under the awning and asks for iced tea lemonade too, 'not too cold, sweetie'.
events.resolve: Brew → cool (hold) → lemons → ice. Cooling too short gives 'okay', never 'off' by itself.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Dottie is a second order in the same session; she uses the standard outcomes.

trigger.when: first order of Strawberry Lemonade after it unlocks

steps: Grandpa (L4 client) shows up with a tiny caboose.
Orders 'caboose-red' strawberry lemonade.
He sets the caboose on the counter as a timer joke.
events.resolve: Muddle strawberries, then the classic steps.

great.extra: Grandpa leaves the caboose as a decor gift (toy_train.glb).

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Mint Lemonade after it unlocks

steps: Rocco, on the pond leg of his mail route, orders mint lemonade between steps.
A duckling waddles in behind him and sits by the stand.
events.resolve: Make mint lemonade. Optional calm serve: skip the noisy ice scoop while the duckling is there.

great.extra: Calm serve: +$5 'Duck Friend' tip on top.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Rocco replaces the generic pond jogger (his favourite drink is mint lemonade).

trigger.when: first order of Black Coffee after it unlocks

steps: Delbert Finch arrives winding a pocket clock.
Orders black coffee, 'quiet cup'.
Coffee counter tutorial: brew → pour.
events.resolve: Brew and pour (tutorial-guided).

great.extra: Delbert becomes a regular (eligible for ev_gen_regular_returns).

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Coffee counter intro. From the next session, Steve, Kit and Theo join the coffee pool (black coffee is in all three of their favourites).

trigger.when: first order of Espresso after it unlocks

steps: The retired dentist visits with Gerald in his travel bag.
Orders an espresso 'before I never hear a drill again'.
Gerald's bag sits on the counter.
events.resolve: Pull one shot inside the timing window.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Honey-Lavender Lemonade after it unlocks

steps: The market vendor who waved you through brings honey and a lavender bunch.
Asks you to try 'the fancy one'.
Recipe card appears (first complexity-3 drink).
events.resolve: Steep lavender → honey → lemons → ice.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Latte after it unlocks

steps: The architect rushes in and sketches a shape on a napkin.
Orders a latte 'with this on top'.
The latte-art step shows the napkin sketch as a ghost.
events.resolve: Shot → steam → pour; trace the napkin shape (a partial match is fine).

great.extra: Architect pins the napkin on your wall (decor).

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Cappuccino after it unlocks

steps: Agnes Pell (librarian) comes in with a book under her arm.
Orders a cappuccino in her library voice.
Ambience dips; loud actions show a soft 'shh' icon.
Wren is already at the window seat, writing; they whisper their cappuccino order after Agnes.
events.resolve: Make the cappuccino; quieter actions (slow tamp, gentle steam) count toward great.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Mocha after it unlocks

steps: Juno Park arrives late, out of breath: 'mocha!! extra whip!!'
She tips well, rushed or not.
events.resolve: Shot → chocolate → steam; optional extra whip.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Iced Coffee after it unlocks

steps: The record store owner drops off a record and puts it on.
Orders iced coffee.
Each step on the beat lights the beat ring.
Kit drums the beat on the counter; following Kit's drumming counts as on the beat.
events.resolve: Cold brew → ice → pour; steps on the beat build a combo (visual ring + haptic).

great.extra: Combo of 3: coupon for the record-player decor.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: first order of Vanilla Latte after it unlocks

steps: The florist brings a vanilla pod from her orchid corner.
Orders a vanilla latte; her watering can goes on the counter.
events.resolve: Shot → vanilla syrup → steam → pour.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.unlock: L16 move-in; repeats each in-game season

trigger.when: first order of seasonal_special each in-game season

steps: Dana chalks the new seasonal flavour on the menu board.
A co-worker reads it aloud and orders one.
The topping changes with the season (winter spice by L20).
Wren is the first in line for every new seasonal flavour.
events.resolve: Shot → seasonal syrup → steam → topping.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: session start; a customer with >= 3 great serves exists

steps: A regular walks in and says 'the usual'.
No order card: the player remembers it, or opens the review log to check.
events.resolve: Make their usual. Opening the log is allowed and caps the result at okay.

great.extra: Loyalty heart +1; at 5 hearts they send a postcard.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Any of the 8 customers can become a regular; their 'usual' is their favourite_drink once it is unlocked, otherwise slice_order.

trigger.when: 2 customers in queue for >= 10 s

steps: Two customers start chatting (Rosa & Ray Pemberton once met).
Their patience timers pause while they talk.
One recommends a drink to the other, changing the second order.
events.resolve: Serve the changed order; timers stay paused until you start it.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Pairs and lines for the 8 customers come from narrative/customers/banter.json (48 exchanges, filtered by context tags); Rosa & Ray keep their scripted first meeting.

steps: Bell rings; 4-5 customers arrive within 20 s.
Rush banner; music tempo up a step.
Patience timers run 25% slower during the rush.
events.resolve: Serve them in any order; batching two of the same drink is allowed.

great.extra: All great: 'Rush Hour Hero' stamp.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

events.notes: Band is the average quality across the rush; rep is for the whole rush, not per order. Rush customers are drawn from the 8 customers first (whoever has appears_from met), then queue_npc.

trigger.when: any session; Biscuit not already in the scene

steps: Biscuit wanders in and sits on the counter (or the stand's cushion crate).
Customers stop to pet him; patience timers pause.
He may sit on an ingredient, which then needs a tap to free.
events.resolve: Tap Biscuit for a scratch; he leaves after 2 scratches or 1 served order.

great.extra: Each customer served while he's there leaves a cat-photo review.

off.extra: Even an off drink gets 4★: 'the cat was worth it'.

trigger.when: neighbor_kid in the queue

steps: Neighbor kid is one quarter short and glances at the tip jar.
events.resolve: Choose 'On the house' or 'Pay me next time'. Both are good.

great.extra: Kid's parent leaves a 5★ review later.

off.extra: No off outcome; it's a choice.

trigger.when: session start

steps: A quiet customer with a notebook orders your most complex unlocked drink.
No timer is shown.
If Pippa is in the shop, she sits beside the critic and copies their notes.
events.resolve: Make the drink; only quality counts.

great.extra: 'Hidden Gems' column: framed clipping decor.

off.extra: 'Promising.' (the critic never goes below 4★)

events.notes: Flavour only; Pippa does not change the critic's outcome.

events.unlock: each office move (L6, L11, L16, L21)

trigger.when: first shop session after an office move

steps: Marge 'Mile Marker' Holloway stops by and orders 'whatever's newest'.
events.resolve: Serve the newest unlocked drink.

great.extra: Marge: 'Logged and loaded.' plus a hint about the next drink.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: weather changes during a session (rain or heat)

steps: Rain: customers crowd under the awning and order iced tea lemonade (or hot coffee once the counter is unlocked).
Heat: everyone asks for extra ice.
Rain: Dottie directs the awning crowd. Heat: Rocco asks for 'all the ice you've got'.
events.resolve: Follow the suggestion shown on the order card.

off.extra: Gentle redo offered; customer stays happy. Only a little stock is used.

trigger.when: end of every session

steps: The review board shows the session's 3 best reviews and highlights a 'fan favourite' drink.
events.resolve: Nothing to do; tap to read.

great.extra: Average >= 4.5★: board glows; +5% tips next session.

off.extra: Average < 3.5★: Dana's sticky note gives one gentle tip. No penalty.

events.notes: Wren's haiku and Pippa's sticker grades show on the board in their own card style.

trigger.when: Steve is in the queue

steps: Steve orders, then asks: 'Are the cups stackable?'
Optional mini stack: set 3 spare cups into a neat stack on the counter (uses the stacking controls).
Steve rates the drink in staples out of five.
events.resolve: Make Steve's order. The cup stack is optional and can't fall badly (cups reset gently).

great.extra: Neat stack: Steve 'acquires' a cup for his collection and leaves exact-change +$2.

off.extra: Steve: 'Two staples. Still holds the pages together!'

events.notes: Ties the shop back to the stacking game.

trigger.when: in-game 17:00-19:00 and Lorna in the queue

steps: Lorna holds her cup up to the low sun before sipping.
Bright drinks (clear ice, pink, garnish) catch the light with a soft glow.
events.resolve: Make her order; an optional garnish adds 'warm wattage' (counts toward great).

great.extra: 'Warm wattage!' She gifts a small lamp decor at her 3rd golden-hour great.

off.extra: 'A little dim, but I brought my own sunshine.'

trigger.when: Kit is in the queue

steps: Kit types the order on the counter in keyboard rhythm.
The order ticket appears as typed text with one friendly typo ('blakc coffee' in the slice; 'expresso', 'lattee' once those unlock).
Tap the typo to auto-correct it (or just make the drink; the game knows what Kit meant).
events.resolve: Make Kit's order. The typo is a joke, never a trap.

great.extra: Kit rates it 'tactile' and posts a 5★ review with a keyboard emoji.

off.extra: 'Bit mushy, like a membrane board. Still paying!'

events.notes: Drink is black_coffee (unlocked L6, when Kit first appears; ticket '1x blakc coffee plz'). Kit's favourite espresso unlocks at L7; from then the ticket can use the 'expresso' variant.

trigger.when: 3+ customers in queue and Dottie is one of them

steps: Dottie stands up, vest on, and waves the line into order.
All patience timers pause for 10 s while she 'directs traffic'.
She lets someone ahead of her: 'You go, sweetie, I'm retired.'
events.resolve: Nothing extra needed; serve as normal. Dottie is served last and always happily.

great.extra: 'Smooth traffic today.' Everyone in the line leaves +1★ (cap 5).

off.extra: 'Slow down, sweetie. You're doing fine.'

events.notes: Pairs well with ev_gen_rush_hour (Dottie can fire inside a rush).

trigger.when: Dottie has 2 great serves; next lemonade-stand session

steps: Dottie brings a paper bag of lemons from Harold's old tree.
She tells you about the tree while you make classic lemonade with her lemons.
events.resolve: Make classic lemonade with Harold's lemons (they count as perfect lemons).

great.extra: 'Harold's lemon tree would be proud.' The lemons become a free restock and a jar-of-lemons decor.

off.extra: 'Lemons were too sour anyway, sweetie. He always said so.'

trigger.when: in-game 6:00-8:00 and Theo is in the queue

steps: Theo shuffles in after a night shift with one heroic yawn.
Orders 'a coffee to sleep after, somehow'.
Optional quiet serve: the shop dims a little while Theo waits.
events.resolve: Make Theo's order hot. Serving it within 60 s counts toward great (a soft timer, no failure).

great.extra: Theo thanks you twice, once for each open eye, and leaves a warm 5★.

off.extra: 'I've had worse at 4 a.m. Thank you, truly.'

events.notes: Drink is black_coffee (unlocked L6, when Theo first appears). His favourite latte unlocks at L9; from then the order line can use the latte variant.

events.unlock: L2 after job (after 5 lemonade orders served)

trigger.when: Pippa is in the queue

steps: Pippa arrives with her clipboard: 'This is an official review.'
She orders a lemonade and watches each step, ticking boxes.
Her rubric card shows 3 boxes: Balance (sweet vs sour), Chill (ice), Service (timing).
events.resolve: Make the lemonade. Each rubric box gets a sticker: gold star (great), silver star (okay) or the 'nice try' frog (off). She always ends with one kind, specific tip.

great.extra: Three gold stars: Pippa's 'Official Seal' sticker goes on the stand (decor).

okay.extra: 'Silver star. Room to grow!' plus one tip for the weakest box.

off.extra: 'You get the nice-try frog. He's very proud of you.' plus one tip; she comes back next session to re-check.

events.notes: Strict but kind: the rubric is honest about which box was weakest, but the tone is encouraging, the stars never drop below 3 and rep never goes down. Rubric boxes map to the quality score parts (ingredients/amounts, ice/temperature, timing window).

trigger.when: next Pippa visit after 2 critiques

steps: Pippa asks: 'What are your profit margins?'
A kid-friendly ledger card shows one drink's price, ingredient cost and profit (from products.json, about 30% margin).
She nods seriously and writes it down.
events.resolve: Read the card and tap 'Makes sense!'. No wrong answers.

great.extra: Pippa: 'Future business partner.' She unlocks her 'Mogul' review stickers.

okay.extra: No okay outcome; it's a read-and-tap.

off.extra: No off outcome; it's a read-and-tap.

events.notes: Soft tutorial for the shop economy.

trigger.when: Rocco is in the queue

steps: Rocco jogs up mid-route: 'Two minutes, chief, step count's on!'
He delivers one piece of neighbourhood gossip while you make his drink.
Serving him fast earns a step-counter 'personal best' bubble.
events.resolve: Make his order. Fast is nice, never required: a slow serve just means more gossip.

great.extra: 'Signed, sealed, delicious!' His gossip is a hint about the next level or drink unlock.

okay.extra: 'Arrived a little dented, but it got here!'

off.extra: 'Return to sender? Nah, I'll keep it. Paid in full!'

events.notes: Gossip lines are hints, so Narrative Writer writes one per upcoming level. Drink is strawberry_lemonade (unlocks L4, when Rocco first appears); his favourite mint_lemonade only unlocks at L5, so his L4 order jokes that the mint is 'still in the mail'.

events.unlock: L6 (coffee counter open) or L8 honey-lavender

trigger.when: after serving Wren any drink

steps: Wren sips slowly and counts the foam bubbles.
Instead of the normal review card, a cream haiku card slides in (3 lines, 5-7-5) with the stars underneath.
Wren leaves the haiku on a napkin as part of the tip.
events.resolve: Nothing extra; the haiku matches the quality band (great, okay or off) and the drink.

great.extra: Golden haiku; the napkin is added to the 'Haiku Book' in the review log.

off.extra: Kind 'brave little cup' haiku; napkin collected. Wren never goes below 4★.

events.notes: Drink is black_coffee (unlocked L6, when Wren first appears); Wren orders black coffee until their favourite honey_lavender_lemonade unlocks at L8, then the card can fire on that too. Haiku text comes from narrative/customers/reviews.json (per_customer.wren and per_customer_product.wren). Design Specialist: the haiku card is a variant of shop_review_card.

trigger.when: session start after the 5th napkin

steps: Wren notices the napkins and asks to pin them up.
Pick a wall spot for a small 'poem corner' (uses the normal placement controls).
events.resolve: Place the poem corner anywhere; every spot works.

great.extra: Poem corner decor; Wren writes a haiku about the shop itself.

okay.extra: No okay outcome; placement always succeeds.

off.extra: No off outcome; placement always succeeds.
